about.lead: Graphic & brand identity designer dedicated to crafting timeless visual languages, meticulous packaging, and cohesive brand systems.
about.bioParagraph1: Over years of partnering with forward-thinking brands, cultural institutions, and founders, I have refined an approach that prioritizes conceptual clarity, understated elegance, and problem-solving through design craft.
about.bioParagraph2: I believe that an enduring visual identity is more than surface decoration—it is a strategic visual language that communicates values with authenticity and poetic restraint.
about.philosophy1Desc: Eliminating the superfluous to focus on core visual elements that grant identities longevity and purpose.
about.philosophy2Desc: Meticulous attention to rhythm, proportions, kerning, and hierarchy across both Arabic and Latin typefaces.
about.philosophy3Desc: Deep appreciation for paper stock, debossing, foil stamping, and how design is experienced physically in the hand.
about.cvUponRequest: Curriculum Vitae is available upon request for prospective collaborations and design commissions.
